rule: Exact canonical-value clusters with at least 3 records; absent values are excluded (empty transportOptions {} is excluded as the honest no-data state). Clusters indicate review risk, not proof that every repeated value is wrong. Disposition per cluster is reviewed in scripts/audit/kai-89-dispositions.json.

disposition.reason: Template vector identical across 114 distinct cities/wards/towns/villages (role=hub). 44 records falsely stamped {rubricVersion:2, method:manual, confidence:high} from a bulk 'Coordinate Calibration' pass with the SAME generic gotokyo.org tourism-board source for all 22 Tokyo wards; 70 have no metad
Nine newly reviewed Kyoto records deliberately use the neutral {5,5,...} placeholder while destination-specific ratings remain unverified; these values are not a positive quality claim.
Formula profile (nature-like offsets: food -1.0, rain -0.9, photo +0.3) at base 8.7 across 27 mixed attractions; all stamped {assisted, low} (honest). Generated, low-confidence.

'Famous attraction' near-flat template (offsets ~0, rain -0.5, photo +0.2) at base 9.0. Sites genuinely notable (Tottori Sand Dunes, Naoshima, Sakurajima) with official sources on ~12/23, so base value plausible; but 21/23 lack metadata and vector is template. Values plausible, unverified.

Hub-city template: identical vector incl. rain 5.5 across 22 climatically disparate cities (Aomori, Akita, Ise, Koriyama...). 4 records (ashikaga-city, choshi-city, hino-city, katori-city) laundered {manual,high}. Hubs scored like attractions.
